max_tire.note: The IH8MUD 100 Series FAQ answer. One owner found 295/75R16 a tight fit on a stock '99 that might not clear at full bump and full lock.

items.title: Steering shaft snap ring
items.summary: After a severe front-wheel impact the snap ring can disengage, and the steering shaft could eventually separate. Dealers fit a redesigned ring and a retainer.

items.title: Side curtain airbag control module
items.summary: A misprogrammed module may deploy the side curtain-shield airbags without a crash. Dealers replace the module.

items.title: Incorrect airbag fitted
items.summary: Some trucks may have the wrong driver or passenger airbag installed. Dealers replace the affected assemblies.

items.title: Daytime running lights too bright
items.summary: The DRLs exceed the FMVSS 108 intensity limit. Dealers add a resistor.

timeline.change: Debuts at the December 1997 LA show and goes on sale in Q2 1998. 2UZ-FE 4.7 V8 (230 hp), A343F four-speed, torsion-bar IFS, with AHC and AVS standard. Front and rear lockers dropped, except for a rear locker on Canadian 1998–1999 trucks.
VSC, brake assist and A-TRAC become standard, and the stronger 4-pinion front differential arrives.
DVD navigation and a standard Mark Levinson audio system.

Facelift. A750F five-speed automatic, 18-in wheels (275/60R18), VGRS steering, curtain airbags and ULEV-II certification at 235 hp. Forum regulars call 2003–05 the years to get, mostly for the five-speed.
VVT-i raises output to 275 hp. LED taillights. One Expedition Portal regular warns the 2006–07 air-injection system can be costly to repair.
Final year. 400 Limited Editions in Black Onyx. Production ends in October 2007.

identify.intro: The LX 470 shares its drivetrain with the 100 Series Land Cruiser, but some equipment differs, and Lexus fitted certain features earlier than the Land Cruiser got them.

items.head: VIN
items.body: US trucks start JTJHT00W. NHTSA's vPIC decoder reads them as the LX 470 with the 2UZ-FE engine, built in Toyota City. The 10th character is the model year (W = 1998, X = 1999, Y = 2000, 1 = 2001 through 7 = 2007).

items.head: LX vs Land Cruiser 100
items.body: Quad multi-reflector/projector headlamps, body cladding on the doors and quarter panels, backlit gauges, different wheels, and AHC with AVS standard from 1998.

items.head: Front differential
items.body: 1998–1999 trucks have the weaker 2-pinion front diff. 2000-on trucks have the 4-pinion unit.

items.head: Steering-shaft recall
items.body: On 2003–2007 trucks, confirm recall 10V-346 was done. Lexus's VIN lookup or a dealer can confirm it.

items.head: 2007 Limited Edition
items.body: 400 built, all in Black Onyx with stone leather and special badging and scuff plates. Check for all three before paying a premium.

values.intro: There's plenty of supply, so prices hinge on the AHC, timing-belt records and miles. The 2007 Limited Edition sits in a class of its own.
values.note: Based on the 20 most recent Bring a Trailer LX 470 sales (August–October 2026), which ranged from $6,000 to $35,325, plus one 2007 Limited Edition at $63,500.
